title: cold
description:
Steam Inhalation

How: Inhale steam from hot water (add a pinch of salt or a few drops of eucalyptus oil if available).

Why: Helps clear nasal congestion and soothe throat irritation.

Do: 2–3 times daily for 5–10 minutes.
